exposure: previous cesarean section timing (before or after cervical dilation)
VBAC group A (previous cesarean section before dilation of the cervix)
VBAC group B (previous cesarean section after dilation of the cervix)
cohort: Women who labored spontaneously and had a VBAC (n = 139) at the Second Affiliated Hospital of Wenzhou Medical University in China between 2016 and 2019
finding: Women who had a VBAC had different labor characteristics, intrapartum interventions, and perinatal outcomes compared to both primiparae and multiparae who did not undergo VBAC.
